  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section references a letter from the second of Iyar, 5702.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And in the letter of the 2nd of Iyar, 5702:</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the Cause of all causes arranged a great mitzvah mission to awaken repentance and prepare for the redemption by writing a Torah scroll specifically for greeting Moshiach Tzidkeinu.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"The Cause of all causes and the Source of all sources,</t>
    <t s="1">blessed and exalted is He,</t>
    <t s="2">in the merit of the honor, holiness, and sanctity of our fathers, our holy Rabbis, of blessed and holy memory, brought about a good cause to merit me with a lofty and exalted mission,</t>
    <t s="3">to awaken and arouse immediately to repentance and to prepare ourselves immediately for the redemption, and to write a Torah scroll specifically for greeting Moshitz Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="4">and the matter of the writing of the Torah scroll was kept secret with me, to do the matter in a private manner,</t>
    <t s="5">however, at the festive meal of Simchas Torah, in our discussion about the virtue of Ahavas Yisrael...</t>
    <t s="6">it occurred to me: was I correct in my judgment to conceal the truth and to prevent many and complete, innocent people from participating in the great and holy merit...</t>
    <t s="7">I decided to announce publicly that with His help, may He be blessed, I intend to write a Torah scroll specifically for the sake of greeting Moshiach Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="8">speedily in our days, Amen."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section references a letter from the 24th of Teves, 5703.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And in the letter of the 24th of Teves, 5703:</t>
  </section>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section references a letter from the second of Iyar, 5702.

translations.translation: And in the letter of the 2nd of Iyar, 5702:

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the Cause of all causes arranged a great mitzvah mission to awaken repentance and prepare for the redemption by writing a Torah scroll specifically for greeting Moshiach Tzidkeinu.

translations.translation: "The Cause of all causes and the Source of all sources,
in the merit of the honor, holiness, and sanctity of our fathers, our holy Rabbis, of blessed and holy memory, brought about a good cause to merit me with a lofty and exalted mission,
to awaken and arouse immediately to repentance and to prepare ourselves immediately for the redemption, and to write a Torah scroll specifically for greeting Moshitz Tzidkeinu,
and the matter of the writing of the Torah scroll was kept secret with me, to do the matter in a private manner,
however, at the festive meal of Simchas Torah, in our discussion about the virtue of Ahavas Yisrael...
it occurred to me: was I correct in my judgment to conceal the truth and to prevent many and complete, innocent people from participating in the great and holy merit...
I decided to announce publicly that with His help, may He be blessed, I intend to write a Torah scroll specifically for the sake of greeting Moshiach Tzidkeinu,
